
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/22359584" title="发布于 2026-08-10 08:51">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.net源生成器必须知道的4套类型</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        熟悉.net的4套类型系统才能更好的掌握源生成器技巧,对普通.net开发理解类型也是助益良多,这里藏着我们写的代码的“前世、今生和未来”
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>.net有4套类型</li>
<li>每一套类型有各自的作用</li>
<li>部分类型之间可以相互转化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="1-typesyntax">1. TypeSyntax</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>全称Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax.TypeSyntax</li>
<li>用于在SyntaxTree中引用类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="11-typesyntax常用子类">1.1 TypeSyntax常用子类</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>PredefinedTypeSyntax</li>
<li>IdentifierNameSyntax</li>
<li>QualifiedNameSyntax</li>
<li>GenericNameSyntax</li>
<li>ArrayTypeSyntax</li>
<li>NullableTypeSyntax</li>
<li>OmittedTypeArgumentSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="12-predefinedtypesyntax">1.2 PredefinedTypeSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>系统预定义类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="121-预定义类型有16种">1.2.1 预定义类型有16种</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>由以下16种SyntaxKind定义预定义类型</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.BoolKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.ByteKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.SByteKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.IntKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.UIntKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.ShortKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.UShortKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.LongKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.ULongKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.FloatKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.DoubleKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.DecimalKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.StringKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.CharKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.ObjectKeyword</li>
<li>SyntaxKind.VoidKeyword</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="122-easysyntax语法">1.2.2 EasySyntax语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.BoolType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.ByteType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.SByteType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.IntType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.UIntType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.ShortType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.UShortType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.LongType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.ULongType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.FloatType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.DoubleType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.DecimalType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.StringType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.CharType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.ObjectType</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.VoidType</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="123-roslyn原始语法">1.2.3 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.BoolKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.ByteKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.SByteKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.IntKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.UIntKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.ShortKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.UShortKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.LongKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.ULongKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.FloatKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.DoubleKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.DecimalKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.StringKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.CharKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.ObjectKeyword))</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.VoidKeyword))</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="13-identifiernamesyntax">1.3 IdentifierNameSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>标识名,这里作为类型标识名</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="131-简单类名">1.3.1 简单类名</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("User")</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="132-含命名空间类名">1.3.2 含命名空间类名</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models.User")</li>
<li>用于指定命名空间</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="133-含全局限定类名">1.3.3 含全局限定类名</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("global::Models.User")</li>
<li>用于排除命名空间不明确</li>
<li>比如在A、B、C三个命名空间下,Models.User的4种分别是(A.Models.User、B.Models.User、C.Models.User和Models.User)</li>
<li>使用global::Models.User就没有歧义</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="14-qualifiednamesyntax">1.4 QualifiedNameSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>前缀类型(含命名空间)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="141-easysyntax语法">1.4.1 EasySyntax语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("User").Qualified("Models");</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="142-roslyn原始语法">1.4.2 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.QualifiedName(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models"), "User")</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="15-genericnamesyntax">1.5 GenericNameSyntax</h3>
<h4 id="151-easysyntax语法">1.5.1 EasySyntax语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.Generic("List", SyntaxGenerator.IntType);</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="152-roslyn原始语法">1.5.2 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.GenericName(SyntaxFactory.Identifier("List"), SyntaxFactory.TypeArgumentList(SyntaxFactory.SeparatedList([SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.IntKeyword))])))</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="16-arraytypesyntax">1.6 ArrayTypeSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>数组类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="161-easysyntax语法">1.6.1 EasySyntax语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxGenerator.IntType.Array();</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="162-roslyn原始语法">1.6.2 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.ArrayType(SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.IntKeyword)), SyntaxFactory.SingletonList(SyntaxFactory.ArrayRankSpecifier(SyntaxFactory.SingletonSeparatedList<expressionsyntax>(SyntaxFactory.OmittedArraySizeExpression()))))</expressionsyntax></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="17-nullabletypesyntax">1.7 NullableTypeSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>可空类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="171-easysyntax语法">1.7.1 EasySyntax语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.NullableType(SyntaxGenerator.IntType);</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="172-roslyn原始语法">1.7.2 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxFactory.NullableType(SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.IntKeyword)));</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="18-omittedtypeargumentsyntax">1.8 OmittedTypeArgumentSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>泛型匿名类型参数</li>
<li>使用方法SyntaxFactory.OmittedTypeArgument()创建</li>
<li>需要结合泛型来使用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var listIntType = SyntaxGenerator.Generic("List", SyntaxFactory.OmittedTypeArgument());
var code = listIntType.ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("List&lt;&gt;", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="19-typesyntax的用法灵活">1.9 TypeSyntax的用法灵活</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>同个功能有多种表示方法,甚至可以用不用子类来表示</li>
<li>当然还可以用SyntaxFactory.ParseTypeName</li>
<li>详情参看<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19695022" target="_blank">.NET源码生成器之SyntaxTree踩坑</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="2-typedeclarationsyntax">2. TypeDeclarationSyntax</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>全称Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax.TypeDeclarationSyntax</li>
<li>用于定义类型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="21-typedeclarationsyntax常用子类">2.1 TypeDeclarationSyntax常用子类</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ClassDeclarationSyntax</li>
<li>StructDeclarationSyntax</li>
<li>InterfaceDeclarationSyntax</li>
<li>RecordDeclarationSyntax</li>
<li>ExtensionBlockDeclarationSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="22-classdeclarationsyntax">2.2 ClassDeclarationSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>定义类</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("User")</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="23-structdeclarationsyntax">2.3 StructDeclarationSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>定义结构体</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.StructDeclaration("User")</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="23-interfacedeclarationsyntax">2.3 InterfaceDeclarationSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>定义接口</li>
<li>SyntaxFactory.InterfaceDeclaration("IEntityId")</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="24-recorddeclarationsyntax">2.4 RecordDeclarationSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>定义记录</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="241-easysyntax语法">2.4.1 EasySyntax语法</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var record = SyntaxGenerator.RecordDeclaration("Person")
    .AddParameterListParameters(
        SyntaxGenerator.StringType.Parameter("Name")
    )
    .WithSemicolonToken();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="242-roslyn原始语法">2.4.2 Roslyn原始语法</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var record = SyntaxFactory.RecordDeclaration(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.RecordKeyword), "Person")
    .AddParameterListParameters(
        SyntaxFactory.Parameter(SyntaxFactory.Identifier("Name"))
            .WithType(SyntaxFactory.PredefinedType(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.StringKeyword)))
    )
    .WithSemicolonToken(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.SemicolonToken));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="25-extensionblockdeclarationsyntax">2.5 ExtensionBlockDeclarationSyntax</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>扩展块,是csharp14新增扩展方法语法</li>
<li>使用SyntaxFactory.ExtensionBlockDeclaration创建</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="251-extensionblockdeclarationsyntax示例">2.5.1 ExtensionBlockDeclarationSyntax示例</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var userIdType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId");
var userId = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("userId");
var incrementMethod = userIdType.Method("Increment")
    .ToBuilder()
    .Return(userIdType.New([userId.Access("Original").Add(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(1))]))
    .Public();
var decreaseMethod = userIdType.Method("Decrease")
    .ToBuilder()
    .Return(userIdType.New([userId.Access("Original").Subtract(SyntaxGenerator.Literal(1))]))
    .Public();

var extension = SyntaxFactory.ExtensionBlockDeclaration()
    .AddParameterListParameters(userIdType.Parameter(userId.Identifier))
    .AddMembers(incrementMethod, decreaseMethod)
    .WithOpenBraceToken(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.OpenBraceToken))
    .WithCloseBraceToken(SyntaxFactory.Token(SyntaxKind.CloseBraceToken));
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("UserIdExtension")
    .Public()
    .Static()
    .AddMembers(extension);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="252-extensionblockdeclarationsyntax示例生成代码">2.5.2 ExtensionBlockDeclarationSyntax示例生成代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>静态类型UserIdExtension中增加一个扩展块</li>
<li>扩展块中用实例方法定义扩展方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public static class UserIdExtension
{
    extension(UserId userId)
    {
        public UserId Increment()
        {
            return new UserId(userId.Original + 1);
        }

        public UserId Decrease()
        {
            return new UserId(userId.Original - 1);
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="3-itypesymbol">3. ITypeSymbol</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>全称Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ITypeSymbol</li>
<li>用于描述类型的编译符号的接口</li>
<li>特别注意,ITypeSymbol和反射的Type还不是一回事</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="31-46种specialtype">3.1 46种SpecialType</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SpecialType与前面的预定义类型类似,就是系统类</li>
<li>通过以下46种枚举SpecialType来定义</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Runtime_CompilerServices_InlineArrayAttribute</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Object</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Enum</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_MulticastDelegate</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Delegate</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_ValueType</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Void</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Boolean</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Char</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_SByte</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Byte</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Int16</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_UInt16</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Int32</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_UInt32</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Int64</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_UInt64</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Decimal</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Single</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Double</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_String</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_IntPtr</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_UIntPtr</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Array</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_IEnumerable</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IEnumerable_T</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IList_T</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_ICollection_T</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_IEnumerator</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IEnumerator_T</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IReadOnlyList_T</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IReadOnlyCollection_T</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Nullable_T</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_DateTime</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Runtime_CompilerServices_IsVolatile</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_IDisposable</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_TypedReference</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_ArgIterator</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_RuntimeArgumentHandle</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_RuntimeFieldHandle</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_RuntimeMethodHandle</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_RuntimeTypeHandle</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_IAsyncResult</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_AsyncCallback</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Runtime_CompilerServices_RuntimeFeature</li>
<li>SpecialType.System_Runtime_CompilerServices_PreserveBaseOverridesAttribute</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="32-获取系统类">3.2 获取系统类</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Compilation.GetSpecialType获取系统类</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">INamedTypeSymbol GetSpecialType(SpecialType specialType);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="33-按类型名获取">3.3 按类型名获取</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName获取类</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var source = @"namespace Tests;
    public enum MyColor : int
    {
        Red,
        Green,
        Blue
    };
    var color = MyColor.Red;";
var compilation = service.Compile(source);
var enumType = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("Tests.MyColor");
Assert.NotNull(enumType);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="34-泛型">3.4 泛型</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Construct方法构造泛型</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var intType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Int32);
// System.Collections.Generic.IList&lt;int&gt;
var genericType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IList_T)
    .Construct(intType);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="4-type">4. Type</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>全称System.Type</li>
<li>用于反射类型信息</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="41-反射获取type">4.1 反射获取Type</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">Type type = typeof(User);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="5-4套类型的生命周期和转化流程">5. 4套类型的生命周期和转化流程</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>第一阶段是语法树,存在TypeSyntax和TypeDeclarationSyntax</li>
<li>第二阶段是编译,转化为ITypeSymbol</li>
<li>第三阶段是链接符号生成程序集,转化为Type</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="6-typedeclarationsyntax转itypesymbol">6. TypeDeclarationSyntax转ITypeSymbol</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>编译含TypeDeclarationSyntax的SyntaxTree</li>
<li>从编译信息中获取INamedTypeSymbol</li>
<li>以下示例使用CSharpCompilation.Create调用编译与日常用IDE编译是一回事</li>
<li>这种场景适用源生成器的单元测试</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// record User(string Name);
var declaration = SyntaxGenerator.RecordDeclaration("User")
    .AddParameterListParameters(SyntaxGenerator.StringType.Parameter("Name"));
var unit = SyntaxFactory.CompilationUnit()
    .AddMembers(declaration);
var compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create("Tests", [unit.SyntaxTree]);
INamedTypeSymbol? userSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("User");
Assert.NotNull(userSymbol);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="7-typesyntax转itypesymbol">7. TypeSyntax转ITypeSymbol</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>用于按TypeSyntax查找原已经存在的类型符号</li>
<li>也可用于单元测试</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="71-nullabletypesyntax转化为specialtypesystem_nullable_t的实现类">7.1 NullableTypeSyntax转化为SpecialType.System_Nullable_T的实现类</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">NullableTypeSyntax nullableSyntax = SyntaxFactory.NullableType(SyntaxGenerator.IntType);
var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
INamedTypeSymbol? symbol= compilation.GetSymbol(nullableSyntax);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
var nullableSymbol = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Nullable_T);
Assert.True(symbol.IsGenericType(nullableSymbol));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="72-predefinedtypesyntax转化为系统类型">7.2 PredefinedTypeSyntax转化为系统类型</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>16种PredefinedTypeSyntax都能转化为对应的ITypeSymbol的系统类型</li>
<li>使用Compilation.GetSymbol扩展方法转化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var intType = SyntaxGenerator.IntType;
INamedTypeSymbol symbol = compilation.GetSymbol(intType);
Assert.Equal(SpecialType.System_Int32, symbol.SpecialType);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="73-arraytypesyntax转化为数组类型">7.3 ArrayTypeSyntax转化为数组类型</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用Compilation.GetSymbol扩展方法转化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">ArrayTypeSyntax arraySyntax = SyntaxGenerator.IntType.Array();
var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
IArrayTypeSymbol? arraySymbol = compilation.GetSymbol(arraySyntax);
Assert.NotNull(arraySymbol);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="74-genericnamesyntax转化为泛型">7.4 GenericNameSyntax转化为泛型</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>泛型转化为GenericNameSyntax或含GenericNameSyntax的QualifiedNameSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">GenericNameSyntax genericSyntax = SyntaxGenerator.Generic("System.Collections.Generic.IList", SyntaxGenerator.IntType);
var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver()
     .Reference&lt;object&gt;();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
if(compilation.GetSymbol(genericSyntax) is not INamedTypeSymbol genericSymbol)
{
    Assert.Fail();
    return;
}
var listSymbol = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IList_T);
Assert.True(genericSymbol.IsGenericType(listSymbol));
</code></pre>
<h2 id="8-itypesymbol转type">8. ITypeSymbol转Type</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Compilation.Emit把Compilation转化为Assembly,把ITypeSymbol转化为Type</li>
<li>以下示例先把TypeDeclarationSyntax转ITypeSymbol,再把ITypeSymbol转化为Type</li>
<li>其中SyntaxTreeDriver封装了CSharpCompilation,方便添加引用</li>
<li>其中ScriptLoadContext封装了Compilation.Emit操作</li>
<li>这种场景适用源生成器的单元测试</li>
<li>也可用于开发插件系统</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// record User(string Name);
var declaration = SyntaxGenerator.RecordDeclaration("User")
    .AddParameterListParameters(SyntaxGenerator.StringType.Parameter("Name"));
var unit = SyntaxFactory.CompilationUnit()
    .AddMembers(declaration);
var driver = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver()
    .Reference&lt;object&gt;();
var compilation = driver.Compile(unit.SyntaxTree);
INamedTypeSymbol? userSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("User");
Assert.NotNull(userSymbol);
using var context = new ScriptLoadContext();
var assembly = context.GetAssembly(compilation);
Type? type = assembly.GetType("User");
Assert.NotNull(type);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="9-itypesymbol转typesyntax">9. ITypeSymbol转TypeSyntax</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>用于按原类型符号生成TypeSyntax</li>
<li>以便生成新代码与原代码高度兼容</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="91-easysyntax语法默认转化方法">9.1 EasySyntax语法默认转化方法</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>调用EasySyntax语法的扩展方法ToSyntax转化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="911-可空类型转化为nullabletypesyntax">9.1.1 可空类型转化为NullableTypeSyntax</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var intType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Int32);
var nullable = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Nullable_T)
    .Construct(intType);
if (nullable.ToSyntax() is not NullableTypeSyntax syntax)
{
    Assert.Fail();
    return;
}
var code = syntax.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("int?", code);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="912-预定义类型转化为predefinedtypesyntax">9.1.2 预定义类型转化为PredefinedTypeSyntax</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var intType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Int32);
if(intType.ToSyntax() is not PredefinedTypeSyntax syntax)
{
    Assert.Fail();
    return;
}
var code = syntax.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("int", code);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="913-数组转化为arraytypesyntax">9.1.3 数组转化为ArrayTypeSyntax</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var intType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Int32);
var arrayType = compilation.CreateArrayTypeSymbol(intType, 1);
if (arrayType.ToSyntax() is not ArrayTypeSyntax syntax)
{
    Assert.Fail();
    return;
}
var code = syntax.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("int[]", code);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="914-泛型转化为genericnamesyntax">9.1.4 泛型转化为GenericNameSyntax</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>泛型转化为GenericNameSyntax或含GenericNameSyntax的QualifiedNameSyntax</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var intType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Int32);
var genericType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_Collections_Generic_IList_T)
    .Construct(intType);
var syntax = genericType.ToSyntax();
if (syntax is not GenericNameSyntax
    &amp;&amp; (syntax is not QualifiedNameSyntax qualifiedSyntax || qualifiedSyntax.Right is not GenericNameSyntax))
{
    Assert.Fail();
    return;
}
var code = syntax.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("System.Collections.Generic.IList&lt;int&gt;", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="92-确人在当前命名空间下使用类名即可">9.2 确人在当前命名空间下使用类名即可</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使调用EasySyntax语法的扩展方法ToMiniName</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var dateTimeType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_DateTime);
var syntax = dateTimeType.ToMiniName();
var code = syntax.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("DateTime", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="93-转化为含全局限定类名">9.3 转化为含全局限定类名</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>调用EasySyntax语法的扩展方法ToGlobalName</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDriver();
var compilation = service.Compile("");
var dateTimeType = compilation.GetSpecialType(SpecialType.System_DateTime);
var syntax = dateTimeType.ToGlobalName();
var code = syntax.NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Equal("global::System.DateTime", code);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="10-结语">10. 结语</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>4套类型的生命周期就是我们代码的“前世、今生和未来”</li>
<li>熟悉这些能更好的理解代码工作的机制</li>
<li>开发.net源生成器这些更是必须掌握的技能</li>
<li>以上例子由Roslyn及其简单封装来支持的</li>
<li>Roslyn主要组件: Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp、Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Scripting</li>
<li>封装组件可以用于.net源生成器的开发:</li>
<li>dotnet add package Hand.Generators.EasySyntax --version 0.2.1.3</li>
<li>dotnet add package Hand.GenerateCore --version 0.2.1.5</li>
<li>dotnet add package Hand.Generators.SyntaxScripting --version 0.2.1.3-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>源码托管地址: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators</a> ，欢迎大家直接查看源码。<br>
gitee同步更新:<a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/hand.-generators" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/hand.-generators</a></p>
